subject: Hostel payment not reflecting after bank payment

messages.author: student
messages.name: Amina Yusuf
messages.body: Good afternoon. I paid my hostel accommodation fee (₦45,000) at the bank on 19 October with RRR 2911-3305-4471, but the portal still shows it as pending. Please help.

messages.author: staff
messages.name: Bursary Support · Grace O.
messages.body: Hello Amina, thank you for reaching out. We have escalated the RRR to Remita for confirmation. Bank branch payments can take up to 72 hours to settle. Kindly attach a copy of your teller if you have it.

messages.author: student
messages.name: Amina Yusuf
messages.body: Thank you. I've attached the teller. Please let me know once it's confirmed.

messages.author: staff
messages.name: Bursary Support · Grace O.
messages.body: Received, thank you. Remita has acknowledged the request; we'll update you as soon as the settlement is confirmed.

subject: Request to correct date of birth

messages.author: student
messages.name: Amina Yusuf
messages.body: My date of birth on the portal is wrong. How can I correct it?

messages.author: staff
messages.name: Academic Office · Ruth M.
messages.body: Date of birth corrections require a sworn affidavit and your birth certificate submitted to the Academic Office (Senate Building, Room 4). Once verified, the record is updated by the registry.

messages.author: staff
messages.name: Academic Office · Ruth M.
messages.body: Your documents have been verified and the record has been corrected. Closing this ticket.
